rows.item: JST PH 8-pin lead, pin n ↔ pin 9−n (flat, no twist), 50 cm, lot of 5 (DATA leads: node J7 → drag chain → DATA port board; camera leads: node J6 → pod J1)
rows.notes: 8 DATA + 2 camera leads; price interpolated from the 6-pin lots, not read: check the 8P lengths on the listing (45–50 cm).  The DATA route is ≈ 38 cm plugs included (constant over the stroke); the spare goes in a wider bend between the node and the chain's fixed end (nothing moves there), never in front of the chain's moving end.  A sled bay's route is ≈ 22 cm (no chain): the slack coiled in the plenum.  On arrival: both plugs show the same face, pin 1 rings to pin 8; twist D+/D− (pins 3-4 at the node) by hand.  Or crimp them: PHR-8 + 16 × SPH-002T-P0.5S, 24 AWG
